pill.desc: white, lyophilized powder in a single-dose vial

tell: Subcutaneous dosing matches intravenous exposure (AUC) but with a roughly tenfold lower peak concentration.

clues.text: It is 83% bound to plasma proteins, and oxidative metabolism by several cytochrome P450 enzymes is its main clearance path.
Supplied as a mannitol boronic ester of a modified dipeptidyl boronic acid, with a molecular weight of 384.24.
Approved under an NDA, as 3.5 mg single-dose vials. Given once weekly in cycles 5 to 9.
No boxed warning; contraindicated in hypersensitivity to the drug, boron or mannitol, and for intrathecal use. Thrombocytopenia and neutropenia are the most common reactions, at 10% or more.
Adult multiple myeloma, and adult mantle cell lymphoma.
A reversible inhibitor of the chymotrypsin-like activity of the 26S proteasome, the complex that degrades ubiquitinated proteins.
The generic name begins with B and has ten letters.
